evidenceHeadRecordedIn: PR #28 and private delivery seal; evidence commit follows this report
metricSeparation: Private process commit, CDP heap/backing and logical payload bytes are distinct; never summed.
metadataAsymmetry: Every condition uses Blob metadata with the selected transport. r12.4 exposes only payload ArrayBuffer directly; metadata still uses Blob conversions.
directArrayBufferLimit: Angular application responseType arraybuffer does not prove absence of internal FetchBackend copies.
limitations: One host, Chromium version and immutable corpus. One triage measurement per arm and three formal replicates per selected arm.
No individual native allocation or definitive leak identified. Native allocator reservation and retained memory remain possible.
Logical counters observe only application payload objects, not internal backend/browser materializations.
Natural idle and final forced GC are distinct; persistent private memory alone does not prove referenced objects.
Hashes attest immutable source containers and preflight server roundtrip; Blob-only measurement does not rematerialize bodies to compute payload hashes.
The formal transport contrast changes metadata transport as well as payload transport; the result does not isolate payload-only attribution.
nextNativeAllocationHypothesis: Testar, com atribuição de alocações nativas e seus lifetimes, se os backing stores dos chunks lidos pelo FetchBackend, a concatenação em Uint8Array e a construção de Blob explicam o residual, distinguindo objetos vivos de memória reservada pelo allocator. Comparar com XHR e separar a contribuição da metadata da do payload. A dependência instalada Angular 20.3.31 acumula chunks, concatena-os e cria Blob no caminho Blob; o caminho arraybuffer também concatena os chunks. Essa leitura de código orienta a hipótese e não identifica a alocação responsável nos dados R12.
